research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: TigerGraph Inc. is focused on enhancing the functionality and management of its graph database technology. Efforts include optimizing log and cache management to handle updates efficiently, ensuring robust permissions management for query operations, and advancing the modeling of dynamic temporal graphs to track topology changes over time. Additionally, the company is developing methods to manage vertex-level access through user-defined tag rules and employing MinHash signatures to facilitate fuzzy string matching on graphs. These initiatives aim to improve database performance, security, and analytical capabilities.

overview_description.description: TigerGraph is a platform for advanced analytics and machine learning on connected data. Based on the industry’s first and only distributed native graph database, TigerGraph’s proven technology supports advanced analytics and machine learning applications such as fraud detection, anti-money laundering (AML), entity resolution, customer 360, recommendations, knowledge graph, cybersecurity, supply chain, IoT, and network analysis. The company is headquartered in Redwood City, California, USA. Start free with tigergraph.com/cloud.
